# [nextpyper summarize]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-cli}

::: {.doc-subject}
Summarize the results of a NextPyper run
:::

::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION}
```bash
nextpyper summarize [OPTIONS]
```
:::

::: {.details summary="Full --help output"}

::: {.cli-manpage}

```{python}
#| results: asis
#| source-code: mock
nextpyper summarize --help 
# ---
import subprocess

result = subprocess.run(["nextpyper", "summarize", "-h"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
```

:::
